text:
Nico Hischier is the kind of captain whose best work rarely shows up in the box score. New Jersey takes 58% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, and after the Devils gave up nine in one game this month, he was the one delivering the honest assessment.

His own finishing is right on schedule, nine goals on 9.6 expected, with eight power-play points. The gap is in everything around him: the Devils have scored 8.2 fewer goals than the chances deserve with him on the ice, and that kind of on-ice bad luck usually swings back. That's why he has only seven assists. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) shows he gets good looks, shots off passes across the slot and from behind the net. Our numbers say he plays most like Jake Guentzel. Our range projects 48 to 69 points, and the assists are where the catch-up should show first.
